To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of a 3D environment for collaborative process model creation is feasible and that it is a promising tool for process modeling in distributed environments.

the use of virtual worlds for collaborative process modeling is a viable option for organizations, and that the use of a 3D environment for collaborative process modelling increases user empowerment and significantly contributes to the collaboration and consensus development of process models.
virtual worlds are a promising technology for collaborative process modeling.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, development, and evaluation of a new collaborative process‐modeling approach, using virtual world (VW) technology.
the development and evaluation of a 3D environment for collaborative business process design.
the development and evaluation of a 3D virtual world collaborative process modeling environment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of virtual worlds for collaborative BPM has the potential to increase the effectiveness of BPM, and to reduce its cost.
the suggested approach is an effective way to support collaborative business process modeling, and can help in reducing the time, effort and cost of the modeling activity.

the use of virtual world technology in process modeling has the potential to increase user empowerment and to add significantly to the collaboration, consensual development of the process model, and the communication between business analysts and the process domain experts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the use of virtual worlds in process modeling can significantly improve the modeling process by enabling the modeling team members to work in an environment where they can easily communicate, interact and collaborate with each other, and where they can share and discuss ideas in an informal manner.

our approach is a promising way to increase the quality of the business process modeling process, and to improve the collaboration among business analysts and domain specialists in a distributed environment.
we have developed a new collaborative process modeler that is based on a new 3D virtual world environment.
The main takeaway from our work is that
virtual worlds can be used to support collaboration in business process modeling.
the use of 3D environments for process modeling can increase user engagement, and thus, improve the quality of the process models.
virtual worlds are a suitable environment for collaborative process model development and can be a viable alternative to the traditional 2D collaborative process modeling tools.
